mentions.name: All-in-one mini SaaS manager
mentions.description: This is a local web UI serving as an all-in-one mini SaaS manager: it combines a text editor and terminal with Claude/Codex integration so you can code apps and edit code in the browser, spin up Docker containers to view previews, and promote those previews to production.
mentions.source_excerpt: A local web UI with text editor and terminal (with Claude/Codex) where you can code apps, edit the code in the browser, view previews (spins up Docker containers) and promote previews to production. An all in one mini SaaS manager.
